      "unit": "F005",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "statement": "For the purposes of this part, Biometrics means a method of verifying an individual's identity based on measurement of the individual's physical feature(s) or repeatable action(s) where those features and/or actions are both unique to that individual and measurable.",
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "This part",

    {
      "unit": "F006",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "statement": "For the purposes of this part, Closed system means an environment in which system access is controlled by persons who are responsible for the content of electronic records that are on the system.",
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "This part",

        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F007",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "statement": "For the purposes of this part, Digital signature means an electronic signature based upon cryptographic methods of originator authentication, computed by using a set of rules and a set of parameters such that the identity of the signer and the integrity of the data can be verified.",

        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "This part",

        "references": null

    {
      "unit": "F008",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "statement": "For the purposes of this part, Electronic record means any combination of text, graphics, data, audio, pictorial, or other information representation in digital form that is created, modified, maintained, archived, retrieved, or distributed by a computer system.",
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "This part",

        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,

        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F009",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "statement": "For the purposes of this part, Electronic signature means a computer data compilation of any symbol or series of symbols executed, adopted, or authorized by an individual to be the legally binding equivalent of the individual's handwritten signature.",
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "This part",

        "context_quotes": null,

        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null

    {
      "unit": "F010",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "statement": "For the purposes of this part, Handwritten signature means the scripted name or legal mark of an individual handwritten by that individual and executed or adopted with the present intention to authenticate a writing in a permanent form, preserving the act of signing with a writing or marking instrument such as a pen or stylus; the scripted name or legal mark, while conventionally applied to paper, may also be applied to other devices that capture the name or mark.",

        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "This part",

        "context_quotes": null,

        "references": null

      "unit": "F011",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "statement": "For the purposes of this part, Open system means an environment in which system access is not controlled by persons who are responsible for the content of electronic records that are on the system.",
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "This part",
        "scope_quotes": ["F002"],
        "context_quotes": null,

      "unit": "F013",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "statement": "Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records shall employ procedures and controls designed to ensure the authenticity, integrity, and, when appropriate, the confidentiality of electronic records, and to ensure that the signer cannot readily repudiate the signed record as not genuine, which procedures and controls shall include paragraphs (a) through (k) of § 11.10.",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records",
        "scope_quotes": ["F013"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["§ 11.10"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F014",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "statement": "Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records must include validation of systems to ensure accuracy, reliability, consistent intended performance, and the ability to discern invalid or altered records among their procedures and controls.",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records",
        "scope_quotes": ["F013"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,

        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F015",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "statement": "Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records must include the ability to generate accurate and complete copies of records in both human readable and electronic form suitable for inspection, review, and copying by the agency among their procedures and controls.",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records",
        "scope_quotes": ["F013"],
        "context_quotes": null,

        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F015",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "statement": "Persons should contact the agency if there are any questions regarding the ability of the agency to perform review and copying of the electronic records.",
        "kind": "recommendation",
        "modality": "should",
        "scope_text": "If there are any questions regarding the ability of the agency to perform such review and copying of the electronic records",
        "scope_quotes": ["F015"],

      "unit": "F016",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "statement": "Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records must include protection of records to enable their accurate and ready retrieval throughout the records retention period among their procedures and controls.",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records",
        "scope_quotes": ["F013"],
        "context_quotes": null,

      "unit_attributes": {
        "statement": "Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records must include limiting system access to authorized individuals among their procedures and controls.",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records",

      "unit_attributes": {
        "statement": "Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records must include the use of secure, computer-generated, time-stamped audit trails to independently record the date and time of operator entries and actions that create, modify, or delete electronic records among their procedures and controls.",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records",
        "scope_quotes": ["F013"],
        "context_quotes": null,

        "modality": "must",

        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records",
